name: Notes on the Pathology of the Self
source:
You are in a bedroom. It is of a decent size, approximately 20 feet by 10 feet, and similarly tall. It is dirty and full of refuse, and the walls are made of bleeding flesh and weeping wounds. What do you do? 

Explore a body horror bedroom to escape the rising sepsis or drown as the body flushes you out like the parasite you are.

[From [url=https://earacorn.itch.io/notes-on-the-pathology-of-the-self]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在卧室里。它尺寸适中，大约20英尺x 10英尺，高度也相似。它很脏，到处都是垃圾，墙壁是由流血的肉和流泪的伤口组成的。你做什么工作？

探索一个身体恐怖卧室，以逃避不断上升的败血症，或者当身体像寄生虫一样将你冲走时淹死。

[来自[url=https://earacorn.itch.io/notes-on-the-pathology-of-the-self]itch.io[/url]]
